description: Derive advisory test-placement findings for one project; use analyze_project_test_placement for multiple audited projects. Pass an existing audit/v1 artifact, or pass repoRoot plus projectRoot to audit that project deterministically. Does not execute tests or create, move, or modify files.

audit.description: An audit/v1 artifact; or pass repoRoot plus projectRoot instead.

changedPaths.description: Optional repository-relative source paths to limit target selection.

goarch.description: Explicit GOARCH for bounded Go build-constraint evaluation.

goos.description: Explicit GOOS for bounded Go build-constraint evaluation.

tags.description: Optional custom Go build tags passed to the target-aware verification command.

owner.description: Optional owner label for the audited project. Defaults to audit.profile.root.

projectRoot.description: Project root relative to repoRoot as detected, such as . or packages/api.

repoRoot.description: Repository root to audit instead of passing audit; requires projectRoot.

swiftSchemes.description: Optional shared Xcode scheme per Swift project root. Keys are detected project roots.

name: analyze_test_placement

outputSchema.description: Top-level shape of this artifact. The complete contract is schemas/test-placement-findings-v1.schema.json in the published package.

title: Analyze Test Placement
